title: V20 streaming client-disconnect durable commit boundary

reproduction.exact_source_fact: stream_openai_responses() creates run_request() as an asyncio task; in generator finally, if the task is not done it calls task.cancel() and gathers it. A client disconnect / generator cancellation can therefore cancel the core request while it is between remote provider progress and local durable publication.

risk: V12/V14/V15/V16/V17/V18 style durable replay is insufficient if transport cancellation can abort the provider->canonical-payload->durable-publication transaction after the Notion thread has advanced. A retry can then re-enter provider planning without a durable exact replay record.
required_invariant: After provider execution has crossed the point where remote conversation progress may exist, loss/cancellation of the HTTP/SSE consumer must not cancel the core transaction before either (a) exact durable publication succeeds, or (b) an explicit durable/fail-closed uncertain marker is established. Transport lifetime and commit lifetime must be separated.
candidate_direction: Before provider start, ordinary request cancellation may abort with no side effect.
After provider start, run the provider->canonical payload->strict durable publication transaction in a task whose completion is not cancelled merely because the SSE consumer disappears.
Do not mutate TurnAffinity/reservation or emit client IDs before durable publication, preserving V12+ ordering.
If durable publication fails, keep persistence blocked/fail closed; do not synthesize a replay response.
Bound the detached commit task with the existing provider/request timeout; do not create an unbounded orphan task.
Add a regression that closes the async generator after provider progress but before commit and asserts durable replay exists with provider call_count=1 on retry/restart.
